It is the પ્રવાસવર્ણન shape and prints no sender block, no salutation and no sign-off — a measured absence recorded by Agents 1 and 4. No agent may invent an addressee, a 'પ્રિય મિત્ર' frame or a second-person letter voice in order to satisfy them. Std-7 label ceiling, chapter-wide: no અલંકાર, છંદ, સમાસ or સાહિત્યપ્રકાર term appears in any authored field, and `figures_of_speech` stays `[]` in every topic — even though this essay runs on picture-language throughout (સોનાની માટી, સોનાની ખાણમાં ફરવા જેવું, ઝરૂખામાં ઝૂરે, રંગોનો પ્રદેશ). At this standard the craft is noticed in plain words, never labelled.

Three vocabulary layers sit on the same pages and each is glossed at the point of use, in the sentence's own sense: તત્સમ description words (અભયારણ્ય, નયનરમ્ય, વ્યૂહાત્મક, સ્થાપત્ય, પરિવેશ, કલાસમૃદ્ધિ), English loans printed in Gujarati script (સેન્ડ ડ્યૂન, નેશનલ સેન્ડ ડ્યૂનપાર્ક, ફોટોગ્રાફી, ક્લિક, ફિલ્મ - દિગ્દર્શકો) which are never written back in Roman letters, and the દેશ્ય-બોલીના શબ્દો the book itself finds hard (ઢૂવા, કૂણો, પહોર, ધમરોળવું, કાઠું, ઠસ્સો). A word used in a narrowed sense is the bigger danger for this reader, because the child reads it confidently wrong and never asks.

The printed શબ્દાર્થ box is evidence of difficulty, never the source of a gloss. Two of its entries do not fit the sentences on the page — વ્યૂહાત્મક is glossed 'સર્વ સ્થળે ફેલાઈને રહેલું વિશાળ' against 'વ્યૂહાત્મક રીતે પણ જેસલમેરનું મહત્ત્વ અનેક ગણું છે', and સહેલાણી is glossed 'આનંદી માણસ' against 'પંખીઓને જોવા માટે સહેલાણીઓ આવે છે' — and three of its words (તળપ્રદેશ, કર્ણપ્રિય, પરિધાન) occur nowhere in this chapter at all. Take every meaning from the sentence the word stands in, and never silently rewrite the printed box, which is Agent 1's verbatim.

Three blanks the chapter deliberately leaves, and gate 4 forbids filling any of them anywhere in the plan: the country beyond 'બીજા દેશની સરહદ' is never named; the director of 'સોનાર કેલા', 'હિરક રાજર દેશ' and 'ગોપી ગાયે બાઘા બાયે' is never named; and the 'આ શહેરના રાજવી' who built the fort is never named, dated or counted in years.

The book's own printed conventions are the page, not errors, and no authored field repairs them when quoting: the spaced ' ?' and ' !', 'દુ:ખ' with its colon-shaped visarga, the spaces around the hyphen in 'ફિલ્મ - દિગ્દર્શકો' and 'રખડતાં - ભટકતાં', and the opening single quote before 'કેસરિયા બાલમા, પધારો મોરે દેશ' that the book never closes.
